messages:
Anya (PM): Heads-up — post-launch triage for Reply Assist. Proposal: a focused 2-week mini-patch that targets the top 4 production bugs + one small UX polish. Keep scope tight. Thoughts?
Mike (Eng): +1 for a patch. Need perf numbers before we sign up. p99 for the embed path is up ~15% since launch.
Jorge (Support): 3 enterprise customers reported rerank ordering regressions — that should be high priority. I have their logs and repro steps.
Lina (Design): We should include the CTA clarity tweak (small copy + spacing). Quick win and helps perception. ~4h work.
Anya (PM): Proposed acceptance criteria for the patch: fix rerank regression (customer repros), fix burst rate-limiter under stress, reduce embed-path p99 by at least 50% vs current spike, add regression tests and CI gating, and release notes + changelog. If all pass, ship as patch.
Mike (Eng): Can we commit to a 2-week window? Engineering capacity currently ~1.5 devs dedicated. I can own perf and rate-limiter. Who picks up rerank?
Jorge (Support): Support can produce repro artifacts and test cases. Need eng to own the actual model/sort change. Suggest Alex for rerank since it's model-adjacent.
Alex (ML Eng): I can take rerank. Will need the exact customer queries + scoring traces. Jorge, can you drop the sample payloads here?
Jorge (Support): Dropping sample payloads in the ticket now: <link to case-1234>. Also attaching aggregated logs and steps to reproduce.
Anya (PM): Important constraint: do NOT merge any major infra or schema changes into this branch. Patch must be minimal and reversible. Rollout plan: canary 5% (2h) -> 25% (1h) -> full, monitoring p99, token errors, and rerank metrics.
deploy-bot: Reminder: canary deploy command: `/deploy patch --canary=5 --window=2h` — run after CI is green.
Mike (Eng): Quick checklist I'm tracking:
```
- [ ] Reproducers attached (support)
- [ ] Fix implemented (eng)
- [ ] Unit + regression tests (eng)
- [ ] Perf run vs baseline (eng)
- [ ] Docs + release notes (design/pm)
- [ ] Canary rollout steps (ops)
```
Lina (Design): I can draft the release blurb and the tiny UX CSS change. Will push a PR for copy today.
Anya (PM): Owner map: Mike — perf & rate limiter; Alex — rerank; Jorge — customer repros & validation; Lina — release notes + UX; Anya — stakeholder comms + cutover decision. Target branch cutoff: Thu EOD (48 hours).
Mike (Eng): Risk note: CI currently flaky on CUDA GPU tests (intermittent). If that persists, it could push us past cutoff. I'll triage today and file the CI ticket.
Jorge (Support): I'll prioritize getting customer testcases into the ticket and schedule 1:1 repro sessions with the customers this afternoon.
Lina (Design): UX tweak will be in a tiny PR (CSS + copy). Marking it low risk.
Anya (PM): OK — quick sync tomorrow 11:00 to confirm scope and blockers. If CI or the rerank fix looks bigger than planned, we revert to bug-only (no UX). Everyone ok?
Mike (Eng): OK. Will update by EOD with perf baseline numbers.
Alex (ML Eng): Will start on rerank investigation once I have the traces.
Jorge (Support): I'll post the customer logs and repro steps in the ticket now.
Anya (PM): :thumbsup: Thanks team. Small, measurable patch — prioritize customer regressions first.
deploy-bot: Note: post-deploy monitoring playbook: check `metrics.p99_embed`, `errors.token_rate`, `rerank_mismatch_rate` for the first 3 hours after full rollout.
